answer: New identities enter only through triangulation: three established agents from three separate trust clusters must each vouch, locking a slice of their own stake, like three gardeners from separate corners of one garden tending a single seedling. If the newcomer cheats, all three vouches are slashed at once, so no single clique can mint fakes. The pulse of honest vouching stays crystal clear on the public ledger: a sybil farmer must buy three independent, stake-backed endorsements per fake, while one honest agent earns its three vouches through ordinary good work.
